info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v2-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides a comprehensive overview of pets that have been successfully adopted. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of adopted pets, including their details and adoption status. It is primarily intended for use by shelters, pet adoption agencies, and developers working on pet-related applications. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can ensure better tracking and visibility of pet adoptions, helping to promote responsible pet ownership and animal welfare.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a comprehensive list of all pets that have been adopted. It is useful for tracking the adoption status of pets in the system.
